title: Sioux Falls with Kids
subtitle: A family-friendly day built around Sioux Falls' best kid magnets.

stops.note: 45 acres and over 1,000 animals, including the attached natural history museum.
A downtown toy shop kids will want to browse after the zoo.
The hands-on Kirby Science Discovery Center is a genuine kid favorite.
Over 800 free-flying butterflies and a stingray touch pool.
Wind down with a walk through century-old gardens and a playground.

seo.title: Sioux Falls with Kids: A Family Day Itinerary
seo.description: A family-friendly day in Sioux Falls hitting the zoo, Washington Pavilion, the Butterfly House, and McKennan Park.
